description:
About the Role

Join an early-stage fintech team building an AI-powered platform for traders. You will create a fast, customizable trading terminal with real-time, data-dense interfaces and embedded AI features.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain responsive, real-time front-end experiences for a trading platform.

  • Develop customizable interfaces that present complex, live-updating market data.

  • Optimize application performance and responsiveness.

  • Integrate AI capabilities into user-facing workflows.

  • Ship production features in a fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For

  • 10 or more years of front-end engineering experience.

  • Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, with solid software engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience building real-time, data-dense front-end applications and optimizing their performance.

  • Experience developing AI-enabled user interfaces.

  • Experience building a web or mobile trading platform is valuable.

  • Background in fintech, trading, crypto, stocks, or financial markets is a plus.

Location

Fully remote. Primary location: Bucharest, Romania.
